title: eriogonum umbellatum var. umbelliferum
intro: Eriogonum umbellatum var. umbelliferum, commonly known as Sulfur Buckwheat or Sulfur Flower Buckwheat, is a flowering plant species belonging to the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum umbellatum var. umbelliferum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are known to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Research has identified the presence of bioactive constituents such as ursolic acid, oleanolic acid, and caffeic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
